reviews.reason: The opening appears to read ወእተ, not the proposed ውእተ, but the opening vowel is not secure enough for acceptance. Prior model agreement cannot establish it. The internal asterisk before እግዚአ is visible; the divine titles and final ዘይመልክ appear consistent with the candidate. Verse 14 ends before XXIII. The facing Greek page does not independently resolve this Ethiopic opening. Hold source and English approval pending secure glyph resolution.
